newsitem.title: USA: Home State units downgraded by A.M. Best.
newsitem.headline: Home State units downgraded by A.M. Best.

text.p: A.M. Best Co said on Wednesday that it downgraded the ratings of Home State Holdings Inc's two property and casualty units to "C" (weak).

These downgrades are based on the substantial deterioration of Home State Holdings' financial condition and follow the company's announcement of a $20.5 million net loss for the year, said A.M. Best, an insurance rating agency.
This rating action applies to the four-member Home State National Pool and the two-member Home State New York Pool, A.M. Best said.

The vulnerable ratings reflect A.M. Best's concern regarding Home State's excessive underwriting leverage, significantly diminished capital strength, marginal financial flexibility and thin resources to service the debt obligations of the parent, A.M. Best said.
Also, A.M. Best is concerned that Home State's financial condition may be subject to further loss-reserve development or a potential regulatory response.
Both ratings remain under review with developing implications, reflecting management's decision to retain a leading investment banker to explore strategic alternatives, A.M. Best said.
